description: Non-streaming LLM completion. Pipeline: route resolution -> PII redaction -> credential unwrap -> retry-wrapped provider call -> ai_gateway.completion insert + ai-gateway.complete.v1 audit. Closes AC-1. VA·E5 (TK-4493): real provider adapters register at boot (AI_GATEWAY_PROVIDER_MODE=real; default real in production, synthetic elsewhere). The openai provider speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions format against any configured base URL (AI_GATEWAY_OPENAI_BASE_URL — OpenAI, Azure-compatible, Groq, Together, vLLM, …) (f618fd2e-e581-4533-a68d-42882358d3b9#AC2). request.tools go out as functions and tool calls come back as tool_calls {tool_call_id, tool_sku, args}; a chat-array prompt keeps its roles, assistant tool_calls and tool_call_id (PII redaction runs per message). tokens_in / tokens_out are the provider-reported usage and are stored on ai_gateway.completion, with provider_cost from the catalog list price (f618fd2e-e581-4533-a68d-42882358d3b9#AC3). A 4xx from the provider (e.g. a rejected key) is not retried. context.tenant_id must be the caller tenant. TK-4494: native anthropic (Messages API, tool_use/tool_result, SSE, ephemeral cache breakpoints on system + tools), gemini (generateContent / streamGenerateContent?alt=sse, functionCall/functionResponse) and bedrock (Converse / ConverseStream with AWS event-stream, SigV4 or Bedrock API key, cachePoint) adapters return text and tool calls with the tenant's key (f618fd2e-e581-4533-a68d-42882358d3b9#AC1).

testCases.name: Completion records consent + budget + redaction + trace

request.prompt: Summarize the onboarding checklist in one sentence.

errorCases.message: context.tenant_id does not match the authenticated tenant
errorCases.when: context.tenant_id names a tenant other than the JWT tenant (it selects whose BYOK key is used); an absent tenant_id is filled from the JWT
Authorization header absent or not Bearer form (requireAuth)

errorCases.message: context.agent_id, context.run_id, and context.trace_id are required
provider not available / no route matches and no provider_hint supplied
errorCases.when: complete() throws an Error whose message includes 'not available' or 'no route matches'
any other error thrown by complete() (kill-switch, provider adapter failure, DB insert failure)
